text: 从国务院新闻办公室举行的开局起步“十五五”系列主题新闻发布会上了解到，市场监管总局相关负责人表示，将继续优化消费者权益保护体系，着力整治侵害消费者权益突出问题，持续规范网络销售、直播带货等经营活动。进一步畅通消费维权渠道，推进消费纠纷多元化解、源头化解，实现在线消费纠纷解决机制覆盖主要网络交易平台，让群众维权少跑腿、少折腾。持续优化消费环境，加强消费领域信用体系建设，努力让老百姓买得放心、用得安心。（央视新闻）
text_en: At the State Council Information Office press conference in the series on starting the 15th Five-Year Plan, a relevant official of the State Administration for Market Regulation said that it will continue to improve the consumer rights protection system, focus on addressing prominent problems that infringe on consumer rights, and keep regulating business activities such as online sales and livestream e-commerce. It will further open up channels for consumer rights protection, promote diversified and source-based resolution of consumer disputes, achieve coverage of online consumer dispute resolution mechanisms across major online trading platforms, and make rights protection less burdensome and less troublesome for the public. It will continue to improve the consumption environment, strengthen the credit system in the consumption sector, and strive to let ordinary people buy with confidence and use with peace of mind. (CCTV News)
